description.narrative: Employers' Federation of Ceylon (EFC), in consultation with Governor of Northern Province and Earnest & Young (E&Y) established an investor delegation in Northern Province in 2023 to promote investment in the war affected Northern Province of Sri Lanka The ILO provided technical expertise to the working group, such as employment, food security, etc. The ILO in partnership with the UN response to crisis. The ILO supported local government in improving the enabling environment for business creation and employment creation. The ILO developed a response plan for the economic crisis that coincides with employment challenges faced by the people in the disaster setting towards a crisis recovery. The ILO, in partnership with the UN developed a strategic humanitarian appeal that have so far pledged more than $ 100 million. in respond to the crisis

description.narrative: QUEEN (one of the SMEs) became instrumental in retaining the GAP certification for their exports. Global Good Agricultural Practice (GAP) certification is highly regarded for demonstrating on-farm food safety and sustainability for dry chili production of 1,061 farmers of sun frost company. This is a strategic move, as the company has begun producing 100% locally sourced diversified products such as chili flakes and powder to the global market. Relevant Government Institutions were supported with the necessary tools and knowledge for identifying and supporting PWDs in developing Business proposals and skills and providing relevant support for business scalability and growth. Mainstreaming Disability in assessments and acceptance of disability as a main criterion for selection for potential partnerships with MSMEs, private companies, and Cooperatives, Specific actions, roles, and responsibilities in mainstreaming persons with disabilities are explicitly stated in the partnership agreements with these organizations. A separate budget line for affirmative action has been included in all the agreements. The ILO worked with farmers to obtain the certification. in 2022, another 12 producers were assisted in obtaining GMP certification. ILO capacitated relevant Government institutions and partners on disability inclusion using ILO's tools and methodologies on mainstreaming disability in the world of work.

Output 4.2. Strengthened capacity of enterprises and their support systems to enhance productivity and sustainability

description.narrative: Six lead private companies have adopted inclusive business models in the Northern province for six value chains to contribute to their sectoral growth. In 2022, two SMEs of dry chili farming trained and obtained certificates on Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and GAP certification, this counts to a total of five entities. Ceylon Biscuit Limited (CBL) developed and applied digital tools in value chains, including the SMART Agro” App, launched for piloting in February 2022, which served the following functions: registered farmers, collected yield, acreage, and production data, provided guidance for cultivation and distributed company updates. The State Ministry of Rural Development – applied the LEED+ approach for six value chains. In 2022, the National Aquaculture Development Authority (NAQDA) implemented sea cucumber marketing through commercial Geographic Information System (GIS) and sensor-based data logging for nurseries, management, and exchange of information with farmers and buyers. The SIYB Association of Sri Lanka (SIYB-ASL) adopted and translated the e-SIYB training manuals into Sinhala and Tamil languages (local languages) The ILO conducted 4 thematic policy dialogues to explore avenues to create a favourable ecosystem for youth entrepreneurship, in collaboration with the Central Bank of Sri Lanka and the Ceylon Chamber of Commerce. The areas covered were a) innovative approach to reach youth entrepreneurship excellence. b) technopreneurs, c) promoting green entrepreneurship, d) role of financial and economic literacy in improving youth entrepreneurship The ILO supported the digitalization of tools, including “SMART Agro App” in 2022 The ILO, with ITC Turin, trained 25 government officers in promotion and facilitation of value chains, linking small-scale farmers with large-scale producers. In partnership with telecom provider, Dialoq Axiata, the ILO introduced “ídeamart”, a business idea development initiative for entrepreneurship clubs established at targeted 52 schools in 6 districts. Launched the “SPARK” youth entrepreneurship promotional competition in collaboration with the Ceylon Chamber of Commerce and 7 private sector-led partners. A national policy symposium on promoting investment and entrepreneurship in Sri Lanka held in May 2023 with the participation of Govt institutions, private sector, academia, and other ecosystem players. Launched a dedicated KAB e-Camous for Sri Lankan youth, targeting 1000 aspirant young entrepreneurs. Coordination with multiple stakeholders - ILO tools on entrepreneurship development (SYIB, KAB, and KAB e-campus)
